remarks: Recently renovated, this two-bedroom residence offers modern design and exceptional convenience in Stamford's vibrant Mid-City location. The open-concept layout features updated flooring, custom millwork, and a contemporary kitchen appointed with quartz countertops and sleek finishes. The primary and secondary bedrooms are thoughtfully designed for comfort and flexibility. The renovated bath is both functional and stylish. One assigned outdoor parking space (#40) is included, with additional on-street parking available. Heat, hot water, and gas are included in rent. Credit score of 670+, liability insurance and references are required. One dog or cat considered. All photos are from previous owner.
